senses.sense_definition: A large food fish found in the Indo-West Pacific region, also known as the Asian sea bass.

examples.text: The chef prepared a delicious fillet of <w>barramundi</w> with fresh herbs.

target_lang_translations.zh: 厨师用新鲜香草烹制了一份美味的<w>尖吻鲈</w>鱼排。

examples.text: Many anglers travel to northern Australia specifically to catch the prized <w>barramundi</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 许多垂钓者专程前往澳大利亚北部，只为钓到珍贵的<w>尖吻鲈</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种分布于印度-西太平洋地区的大型食用鱼，也称为亚洲鲈鱼。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代这种常见的食用鱼，即亚洲鲈鱼。
在港澳及部分地区对尖吻鲈的常用称呼。

senses.sense_definition: A type of freshwater fish belonging to the Osteoglossidae family, native to Australia.

examples.text: The <w>barramundi</w> in this river are known for their unique, bony scales.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这条河里的<w>澳洲星点龙鱼</w>以其独特且坚硬的鳞片而闻名。

examples.text: Researchers are studying the habitat requirements of the <w>barramundi</w> to ensure its conservation.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员正在研究<w>澳洲星点龙鱼</w>的栖息地需求，以确保对其进行保护。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种原产于澳大利亚的骨舌鱼科淡水鱼。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代骨舌鱼科中原产于澳大利亚的品种。

senses.sense_definition: The Australian lungfish, a primitive species of fish capable of breathing air.

examples.text: The <w>barramundi</w> is considered a living fossil due to its ancient evolutionary lineage.

target_lang_translations.zh: 由于其古老的进化谱系，<w>澳洲肺鱼</w>被视为活化石。

examples.text: Conservationists are working to protect the river systems where the <w>barramundi</w> resides.

target_lang_translations.zh: 环保人士正致力于保护<w>澳洲肺鱼</w>栖息的河流系统。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 澳大利亚肺鱼，一种能够呼吸空气的原始鱼类。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代这种具有原始进化特征的肺鱼。
